nodes.label: Purrly App Logo
nodes.description: The Purrly app logo features a stylized monogram letterform combining a 'P' with a cat silhouette. The 'P' is rendered in a continuous rounded stroke that curves at the top into two small pointed cat ears, forming an integrated icon. The wordmark 'purrly' appears below in a rounded, friendly sans-serif typeface. The color palette uses a warm amber/orange (#E8903A or similar) on a soft cream/off-white background, evoking warmth and approachability. The overall brand identity communicates a pet-focused (feline) app — playful, modern, and friendly — consistent with a cat-care or pet social platform.

nodes.label: Purrly Wordmark Typography
nodes.description: The wordmark 'purrly' uses a rounded, geometric sans-serif typeface in lowercase. The letterforms have soft terminals and consistent stroke weights, conveying friendliness and approachability. Color matches the icon: warm amber/orange.

nodes.label: Purrly Cat-P Monogram Icon
nodes.description: The logomark is a single continuous rounded stroke forming the letter 'P' whose upper loop terminates in two small upward-pointing cat ears. The spiral tail of the P curves inward creating a cat-face silhouette. Monoline stroke weight, amber/orange fill on cream background.
